about: Modwerk site-owned packages imported from toonst/digitakt2-perform release v1.0.

mods.title: Direct perform
mods.summary: PRESET alone toggles PERFORM KIT; FUNC + PRESET opens the PRESET/KIT menu.
mods.author: toonst
mods.on_unit: The author reports the key swap working on Digitakt II OS 1.17 in an earlier version that also had a PERSONALIZE on/off row. The current pair with perform-levels is not reported tested together on a unit.

mods.title: Perform keeps levels
mods.summary: Track levels set in PERFORM KIT mode stay when you leave it; every other parameter returns to the pattern's kit.
mods.author: toonst
mods.on_unit: The author reports perform-levels working on Digitakt II OS 1.17. The pair with perform-direct is not reported tested together on a unit.
